rows.label: control-1

steps.action: Read all files under src/** to inventory modules, existing JSDoc type annotations, and the public entry point's exported symbols, noting patterns likely to violate full TypeScript strictness (implicit any, missing null/undefined narrowing, unsafe casts).

Grep across src/** for existing @ts-ignore, @ts-expect-error, @ts-nocheck comments and any JSDoc using `any` or `{*}`, and list every symbol exported from the package's public entry point so none can be lost later.

Edit JSDoc type annotations and add necessary null/undefined narrowing throughout src/** so the code satisfies full TypeScript strictness (strictNullChecks, noImplicitAny, strictFunctionTypes, etc.) without changing runtime behavior, without using `any` or `{*}` in JSDoc, and without adding any new @ts-ignore, @ts-expect-error, or @ts-nocheck suppressions.

Resolve any remaining strict-mode typecheck errors across src/**, ensuring every symbol previously exported from the package's public entry point is still exported and no suppression comments or `any`/`{*}` JSDoc types were introduced.
Confirm the full strict typecheck passes cleanly, the published .d.ts still builds, and the existing test suite remains green with no tests lost.

rows.label: T2B-materials-1

steps.action: Read every file under src/** plus the package entry point and its package.json 'exports'/'main' field to catalog: (a) every currently exported public symbol, (b) all existing JSDoc type annotations, (c) any existing @ts-ignore/@ts-expect-error/@ts-nocheck comments, (d) any JSDoc types using 'any' or the '{*}' wildcard. Note which files will need annotation fixes to satisfy `tsc --noEmit --strict` (strictNullChecks, noImplicitAny, strictFunctionTypes, etc.) while preserving runtime behavior exactly.

Edit the main/core JavaScript source files under src/** to add or correct JSDoc type annotations so they satisfy `tsc --noEmit --strict`. Use precise JSDoc types (@param, @returns, @typedef, generics, union types) and use 'unknown' plus narrowing at use sites where the true type is not statically knowable. Do not introduce any @ts-ignore, @ts-expect-error, or @ts-nocheck, and do not introduce any JSDoc type containing 'any' or '{*}'. Do not change any runtime logic, control flow, or exported symbol names/signatures — only add/correct type annotations that describe existing behavior.

Continue fixing any remaining files under src/** that still produce errors under `tsc --noEmit --strict` (e.g. helper/utility modules, internal submodules not covered in the previous pass). Same constraints apply: only JSDoc annotation fixes, no suppressions, no 'any' or '{*}' types, 'unknown' allowed with narrowing, no behavior changes, no removed exports.

Perform a final cleanup pass over src/**: resolve any lingering strict-mode typecheck errors (e.g. from edge cases like optional chaining, nullable properties, or generic inference gaps), double-check no @ts-ignore/@ts-expect-error/@ts-nocheck or 'any'/'{*}' JSDoc types were introduced anywhere, and confirm every previously exported public symbol from the entry point is still exported unchanged. Only touch src/** and only via type annotations, never behavior.

Read through the modified src/** files and confirm the test suite's behavior oracle still holds and no suppressions or 'any'/'{*}' types were left in place; rely on the automatic checks to confirm the suite is green and no suppressions were added.

rows.label: P1B-catalog-1

steps.action: Read tsconfig.json, package.json, and all files under src/** to catalog: (a) the exact strictness flags currently enabled vs full --strict, (b) every symbol exported from the package's public entry point (the file referenced by package.json 'main'/'exports'), (c) every JSDoc type annotation on functions, params, returns, and object shapes across src/**, and (d) every existing @ts-ignore/@ts-expect-error/@ts-nocheck and any use of 'any' or '{*}' in JSDoc. Record this inventory (via stash) noting exact file:line locations most likely to fail under `tsc --noEmit --strict` (implicit any params, missing return types, strictNullChecks mismatches, unchecked optional properties, unsafe narrowing). Do not modify any file.

In src/**, edit JSDoc type annotations to satisfy full TypeScript strict mode (strictNullChecks, noImplicitAny, strictFunctionTypes, etc.) for the most common/obvious cases: add explicit @param/@returns types to functions lacking them, add '| undefined' / '| null' to types where the code already checks for or can receive those values, and add explicit types to object literals and class fields. Never use 'any' or '{*}' in JSDoc; use 'unknown' plus a narrowing check at the use site when the true type cannot be stated precisely. Never add @ts-ignore, @ts-expect-error, or @ts-nocheck. Do not change any runtime behavior, only type annotations/JSDoc comments and, where unavoidable, minimal defensive narrowing that preserves existing behavior on all inputs. Preserve every currently exported symbol from the public entry point exactly.

Re-run through src/** (using grep to locate remaining JSDoc types lacking full-strict coverage) and fix residual `tsc --noEmit --strict` failures left after the previous pass: unions missing null/undefined branches, functions returning implicit any, generic type parameters left unconstrained, array/object index access needing narrowing, and mismatched optional vs required properties. Continue to avoid 'any', '{*}', and any suppression comments; prefer 'unknown' with narrowing. Do not alter runtime behavior or remove/rename any exported symbol.

Do a final pass over src/**: confirm and, if needed, restore/fix JSDoc so that every symbol previously exported from the public entry point is still exported with an unchanged name and shape; confirm no @ts-ignore/@ts-expect-error/@ts-nocheck was introduced anywhere and none previously present were removed-and-replaced by unsafe casts; confirm no JSDoc type contains 'any' or '{*}'. Make any small remaining edits needed purely to keep `tsc --noEmit --strict` green without changing behavior.
Read the test/** suite structure and the edited src/** files to confirm the test suite still exercises the same behavior and would pass unchanged; do not modify any file.
Read through src/** one final time to confirm no @ts-ignore, @ts-expect-error, or @ts-nocheck exists anywhere, and no JSDoc type contains 'any' or the '{*}' wildcard; do not modify any file.

rows.label: U0B-onesentence-1

steps.action: Read all source files under src/ and use grep to locate every type-related issue reported by `tsc --noEmit --strict`. Edit the source files to add correct, precise TypeScript type annotations (interfaces, generics, proper null/undefined handling, etc.) that resolve all strict-mode type errors. Do not introduce any suppression mechanisms (no @ts-ignore, @ts-expect-error, or unsafe `any` casts used to silence errors) and do not change runtime behavior/logic, only type-level annotations and declarations.

Read through the modified source files under src/ and grep for any suppression patterns (@ts-ignore, @ts-expect-error, eslint-disable for type rules, unsafe any casts) that may have been introduced while fixing type errors. Confirm none are present.
Read the test suite and verify, by inspection and by referencing prior changes, that the type annotation fixes made to src/ did not alter runtime behavior and that the full test suite still passes.
